name: zvideo_dd3d_submit_polygon
description: zVideo_dd3d::SubmitPolygon prepares textured polygon color/specular attributes, then queues or immediately draws opaque and transparent triangle fans.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo polygon submission pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4abb20 validates the zvid_ddd3d.c source file, fastcall vertices in ECX and uvPairs in EDX with stack attr1/attr0/attr2/vertexCount/renderClass/renderParam/alpha/queueMode arguments, ret 0x20 cleanup, and no return value.

The function computes attr1Scale as 1.0f - attr1[0], prepares alpha bits from alpha or 0xff000000, fills reversed per-vertex specular from attr2 or 0xff000000, and fills reversed colors from grayscale attr1Scale or attr0-biased RGB with channel normalization.

The opaque path is selected only when renderClass->textureMapBlend is not 4 and alpha is at least 1.0. It reverse-copies position/rhw and UV data while preserving prepared color/specular, appends the fan-close vertex when g_zVideo_D3DAppendFanCloseVertexPending is set, and clears that flag.

Opaque queueMode != 0 appends an overwrite queue entry of type 5 and memcpy-copies the prepared TL vertices. Opaque queueMode == 0 updates cached D3D shade mode to 2, texture handle, forced texture map blend 2, and texture address U/V state as needed, then calls IDirect3DDevice2::DrawPrimitive with D3DPT_TRIANGLEFAN, D3DVT_TLVERTEX, the temporary TL vertex buffer, prepared vertex count, and flags 0.

The transparent path is selected when textureMapBlend is 4 or alpha is below 1.0. It writes overwrite queue type 0 or sorted queue entries with reversed position/UV data, prepared color/specular values, optional fan-close vertex, renderClass, renderParam, and updated vertexCount.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4abb20 has no warning tags. Direct callees are _ftol provider glue, zError::ReportOldNoOp at tier S, and zVideo_dd::ReportError at tier C or better; the 0x7c8ed0 frontier token corresponds to Binary Ninja __builtin_memcpy for rep movsd. Direct3D SetRenderState and DrawPrimitive calls are provider vtable dependencies.

Native smokes verify opaque overwrite queue type 5 behavior with fan-close, transparent sorted queue behavior with alpha/specular preparation, immediate opaque render-state cache updates, DrawPrimitive provider arguments, cache-hit immediate draw behavior, transparent overwrite queue behavior, attr0-biased normalized color, and fan-close clearing.
